title: Papoose Lake map altered eight days after Lazar went public

tellings.quote: But the stamp of the exact day is May 23rd, 1989. Exactly 8 days after Bob went public.

plain: Government geological maps of Groom Lake and Papoose Lake, dry lake beds on the Nevada Test Site, were modified on May 23, 1989, which a researcher named Luigi Vendittelli points out was exactly eight days after Bob Lazar went public. Lazar is a man who in 1989 claimed he had worked on alien craft near Papoose Lake. Vendittelli says he found the date stamped on the US Department of the Interior maps himself, and if the timing is not chance it would mean the government changed its maps in response to Lazar's story.
